summary: Tested the new gym-admin manual door-open feature (DoorControl) end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases passed (GET /api/gym/doors as admin+staff; long-poll near-instant delivery; invalid direction 400; bad gym_token 401; exclusivity so a command is never delivered twice via heartbeat+wait; 60s expiration of unpicked manual commands; access_log + dashboard occupancy increment). Frontend (external preview URL, with a background Python Pi simulator long-polling the device): logged in as gym_admin -> DoorControl card renders at top of dashboard with door-row, mode shows 'Instantaneo', clicks on door-open-entrada and door-open-salida produce spinner -> 'Abierto' + Spanish toast within 0.80-0.84s. Admin Accesos page shows 'Apertura manual' badges (data-testid access-type-{id}) and the ocupacion counter reflects manual entries/exits. Staff (gym_manager) can also see and use the buttons (0.83s). Super admin (no gym_id) correctly does NOT render the door-control card. All leftover pending commands drained via the Pi simulator; no residual devices created.
critical_code_review_comments: device_management_routes.open_gym_door inserts the access_log BEFORE confirming command delivery. If the command later expires or fails the log remains counting toward aforo. Consider marking the access_log as 'pending'/'failed' when the command result is non-success, or deleting it on expiration.

_pop_pending_command is used by both long-poll and heartbeat and relies on find_one_and_update atomicity (good). However the sort by created_at string works correctly only while all created_at are ISO UTC strings - ensure no non-UTC writers exist elsewhere.
device_wait_command sleeps asyncio.sleep(0.3) in a busy loop - fine for a few devices but could be replaced by a change-stream / pubsub for scale.

DoorControl.handleOpen passes door.instant captured at click time; if the Pi disconnects between click and completion the 8s timeout may be too short - consider always using 25s and showing a quick skeleton toast if >3s elapsed.
Open endpoints only check role + gym ownership but there is no rate-limit; a tapped-twice admin could flood with manual access_logs. Debounce in UI + idempotency key would help.
No audit of 'created_by' name/email in access_log vs opened_by_name (both are set from admin.name/email, so basically duplicated).

Admin dashboard route is /admin (not /admin/dashboard). Measured open latency 0.80-0.84s via external URL - well within the 'instant' expectation.
